text:
Dresden’s median asking rent sits at 9.53 €/m² in June 2026, up 4.2 % year‑on‑year and 24.5 % over the past five years, placing the city 32nd among the 37 most expensive German markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 38 %, with a typical 60 m² apartment costing about 572 € per month.

The market remains balanced, with a vacancy rate of 2.7 % and listings staying on the market for an average of 27 days; 30 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 13.4 %, while the median asking rent sits between the 25th percentile (8.5 €/m²) and the 75th percentile (11.49 €/m²).

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.07 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging from 9.8 €/m² to 10.31 €/m², implying a 5.7 % increase.
